posts.title: Building Software for Humans and Agents
posts.description: I've been building a library and a framework in parallel, and the same design constraint keeps showing up in both: every piece of software now has two audiences, humans and agents. Here's what that changes — for libraries, and for frameworks.

posts.title: Announcing Keryx: A Full-Stack TypeScript Framework for APIs and MCP Servers
posts.description: After 14 years of building Actionhero, I built a new framework from scratch. Keryx lets you write one Action class and deploy it across HTTP, WebSocket, CLI, background tasks, and MCP — all with the same validation and middleware.

posts.title: curl for MCP: Why Coding Agents Are Happier Using the CLI
posts.description: We're building increasingly complex integrations to connect coding agents to MCP servers. But these agents already know how to use the CLI. So why are we teaching them a new interface?
